tasks.title: Compact collapsed task card and mixed-script title alignment
tasks.outcome: Task cards stop repeating the person's name and keep mixed-language titles next to their checkbox.
tasks.goal: Implement netbka/Dyk#431 and #409 in the shared task-card renderer on current main. For #431: in person-grouped boards, suppress the redundant 'For: <same person>' label while keeping an accessible attribution-correction action; keep attribution where no heading sets it; keep the title and overdue date first, with source on a compact bidi-isolated, safely truncated secondary row; keep 44px hit targets. For #409: keep mixed-script titles next to their completion control in wide RTL and LTR cards without forcing a global direction. Read both issues and #458 with gh. Update the affected Production/Tasks and Production/Assistant stories with synthetic RU/EN/HE states, and add focused tests for the semantic redundancy and the state-dependent rendering.
constraints: Reuse the existing renderer, design tokens and bidi helpers (#349, #403); no new style system or global CSS rework.
Do not implement #433 expanded-detail scope here.
acceptance: No duplicate person label in grouped state; overdue date is next to the title; no action or content is lost; RTL title stays beside its control.
Focused tests pass, plus Dyk's required non-SQL checks for the touched files and npm run storybook:build, with exact commands and results.
The report gives a #473 gate checklist with verdict UNREVIEWED and lists the RU/EN/HE 320/390 and wide states a reviewer must inspect.

tasks.title: Decision-ready expanded task details with inline original evidence
tasks.outcome: Opening a task shows what to do, for whom, by when, how and why, with the original messages.
tasks.goal: Implement the expanded task-detail view for netbka/Dyk#433 on main after COMPOSE-431 is merged, superseding draft PR #433 without rewriting it. Carry over its contract doc (git fetch origin pull/433/head; docs/reviews/expanded-task-card-correction-2026-10-09.md) and extend it to the #458 target and PRINCIPLES U14: in place, answer what, for whom, when (and what the date means), how (instructions and safe clickable links, reusing app/public/text-links.js) and why (relevant original messages with sender when known and time). The Reader stays optional. Show truthful missing states for original, author, deadline and URL. Keep source evidence visibly distinct from inference. Do not add a persistent subtasks feature. Use the shared renderer/view model in Tasks and Summary. Update synthetic stories and add focused tests.
constraints: Reuse the authorized reader, source projection, safe return and bidi helpers from #349/#400 and the source-label work from #471. Never invent deadlines, payments, authors or links.
Preserve the COMPOSE-431 collapsed composition; do not reopen it.
acceptance: Every #473 gate item (decision-readiness, evidence versus inference, truthful missing states) is addressed in code, with a focused test per state: saved original plus safe URL, missing original, unknown author, unknown deadline, invalid URL, no permission.
